natal.item.big3.0.career: Your Sun in Cancer is the centre of your working identity: you do your best work when you're protecting something or someone, and when the work feels like it matters to people. Because the Sun rules your 10th house of career, your public role and your sense of purpose are tied together; work that's only a job won't hold you. In the 8th house, your gifts often show up behind the scenes, with other people's resources, sensitive information or difficult changes.

natal.item.big3.1.career: Moon in Aries in the 5th: you need to feel some spark, initiative and creative play at work. Long stretches of grey routine drain you faster than hard work does.

natal.item.big3.2.career: Sagittarius rising meets work with candour, curiosity and a big-picture view. People first see you as someone with ideas and a point of view; let that be part of how you present yourself.

natal.item.planets.0.career: Mercury in Leo in the 9th house is a mind built for ideas with meaning behind them: policy, principles, teaching, publishing, anything that explains why. You think in big frames and you communicate with conviction, so you're at your best when you can stand behind what you say and shape how a problem is understood. Watch for over-identifying with your ideas; feedback on the work isn't feedback on you. Writing, advising and presenting are natural outlets.

natal.item.planets.1.career: Venus in Gemini in the 7th: you do well through partnerships, conversation and variety. Collaborators who keep you curious bring out your best work.

natal.item.planets.2.career: Mars in Taurus in the 5th gives you slow-building, steady drive: once you commit to something you enjoy, you keep going long after others stop. You work best when you can build at your own pace and see something tangible grow. Pushing you to hurry backfires; so does work with no creative ownership. The risk is stubbornness, staying with a plan because you've started it. Choose carefully what you commit to, because you will see it through.

natal.item.planets.3.career: Jupiter sits right on your Sun in Cancer in the 8th house, so growth and opportunity come to you through trust: people bring you into sensitive matters, shared money or complex situations because you can be relied on. Your luck at work tends to come through relationships and responsibility for others' resources, not through self-promotion. The watch-out is overcommitting, saying yes to everything because you can.

natal.item.planets.4.career: Saturn in Capricorn in your 2nd house is serious about earning and security: you build your income slowly, through competence, and you're unlikely to be reckless with money. Retrograde, its lessons are inner ones: questions of what you're worth and whether you're allowed to charge for it. This placement rewards long-term mastery and structures you control. It can also make you hold onto a safe salary longer than you need to, out of caution rather than choice.

natal.item.planets.5.career: Uranus in the 1st house: you need room to do things your own way. Rigid hierarchy chafes, and you're at your best as the person who brings a different angle.

natal.item.planets.6.career: Neptune in the 2nd: ideals and money are tangled for you. You'll want work that means something, but write the numbers down; vagueness about pay is a real risk.

natal.item.planets.7.career: Pluto in Scorpio in the 12th: you have quiet staying power and a feel for what's really going on beneath the surface. Research and behind-the-scenes influence suit you.

natal.item.planets.8.career: North Node in Aquarius in the 3rd: growth comes through sharing your ideas widely: writing, teaching, networks and everyday conversations, more than through one big stage.

natal.item.planets.9.career: Your Midheaven is at the very last degree of Leo, so your public role wants visibility and authorship: to be known for your own work, with your name on it. Leo here is creative, generous leadership, and the late degree gives it a sense of urgency, as if this calling has been waiting. Sitting anonymously inside someone else's output will always feel slightly wrong. Mars trines it, so your effort turns into reputation when you put it behind something you've chosen.

natal.item.houses.0.career: Sagittarius on the 1st with Uranus there: you approach work as an explorer and an original. Independence isn't a perk for you; it's part of how you function.

natal.item.houses.1.career: Your 2nd house, the house of earning, has Capricorn on the cusp with Saturn and Neptune inside it. You earn best through structure, expertise and patience, and you'll want what you earn to reflect your values. Saturn asks you to price your work properly and build steady income; Neptune can blur the edges, making you undercharge or avoid the money conversation. A clear rate and written terms protect you more than they would most people.

natal.item.houses.2.career: Aquarius on the 3rd with the North Node: your ideas grow by being shared. Writing, explaining and networking are career assets, not side activities.

natal.item.houses.3.career: Aquarius on the 4th: a home base with freedom and room for your own ideas helps you work well. Working from home may suit you more than you'd expect.

natal.item.houses.4.career: Moon and Mars in the 5th: you need creative ownership and some enjoyment in the work. Projects you can make your own give you energy.

natal.item.houses.5.career: Your 6th house of daily work has Taurus on the cusp and no planets in it. You need daily work that's steady, unhurried and grounded in something real; comfort and a good pace aren't luxuries for you, they're how you stay productive. An empty house isn't an empty life area: its ruler, Venus, sits in your 7th house, so your day-to-day work goes best through partnership and good working relationships.

natal.item.houses.6.career: Gemini on the 7th with Venus there: you work well with partners and clients, especially when the relationship is lively and the conversation keeps moving.

natal.item.houses.7.career: Sun and Jupiter in the 8th: you're trusted with sensitive matters, shared resources and difficult changes. Advisory and behind-the-scenes roles often suit you.

natal.item.houses.8.career: Mercury in the 9th: your mind belongs in the world of principles, policy, teaching and big questions. Work that asks "why" keeps you engaged.

natal.item.houses.9.career: Your 10th house of career has Leo on the cusp, ruled by the Sun. You're meant to be seen for your own contribution: leadership by expertise and warmth, a recognisable voice, work you can put your name to. With no planets in the 10th, career isn't driven by restlessness; it follows your Sun, so it flourishes when what you do lines up with what you care about. Your Sun sits in the 8th, which often means the path to recognition runs through trusted advisory work first.

natal.item.houses.10.career: Libra on the 11th: fair, cooperative networks and professional communities serve you well. Peers who share your values open doors.

natal.item.houses.11.career: Pluto in the 12th: you need private time to think. Your best insights often come in solitude, then go out into the world.

natal.item.aspects.0.career: Sun square Moon: what you aim for and what you need don't always match. Building work you enjoy, not only work that's important, closes that gap.

natal.item.aspects.1.career: Sun conjunct Jupiter, almost exact: generosity, confidence and a sense of meaning amplify your purpose. People sense your goodwill and bring opportunities to you.

natal.item.aspects.2.career: Your Sun opposes Saturn almost exactly, so your sense of purpose and your need for security sit on a seesaw. One side says "do the work that matters"; the other says "don't risk the income". This tension is the engine of a serious career: it makes you careful, reliable and, over time, genuinely expert. The trap is letting Saturn's caution win every time. Saturn rewards decisions made with a plan and a timeline, not decisions avoided.

natal.item.aspects.3.career: Sun opposite Neptune (wide): beware idealising a role or an organisation. Check the real conditions before you commit.

natal.item.aspects.4.career: Sun trine Pluto: you have staying power and influence when you're working on something you believe in, and you handle intensity well.

natal.item.aspects.5.career: Moon sextile Venus: you get on easily with people at work, and a pleasant working environment genuinely improves your output.

natal.item.aspects.6.career: Moon square Jupiter: you can take on too much because you feel you should. Promise less, and deliver what you promise.

natal.item.aspects.7.career: Moon square Saturn is the part of you that feels responsible for everything and isn't sure it's allowed to rest. At work it makes you dependable and hard on yourself in equal measure. It often shows up as tiredness that comes from duty, not from the work itself. Build structures that hold you, like set hours, clear scope and someone to report to, so you don't have to hold everything in your head.

natal.item.aspects.8.career: Moon square Neptune: your mood soaks up your environment. Choose workplaces and clients that don't leave you drained or unclear.

natal.item.aspects.9.career: Moon trine Ascendant: your feelings show, and that reads as warmth and honesty. It makes you easy to trust in a first meeting.

natal.item.aspects.10.career: Mercury square Mars: you argue your case with force. In negotiations it's a strength; in tired moments it can make you sharper than you mean.

natal.item.aspects.11.career: Mercury quincunx Uranus: your best ideas come at odd angles. You need room to experiment with how you think and work.

natal.item.aspects.12.career: Mercury opposite the North Node: you grow by sharing ideas in everyday, practical ways, not only in big pronouncements.

natal.item.aspects.13.career: Venus quincunx Saturn: what you enjoy and what you think you should do need constant small adjustments. Let enjoyment count when you weigh options.

natal.item.aspects.14.career: Mars trine Uranus: you act well on sudden openings. When an unexpected chance appears, you can move quickly and inventively.

natal.item.aspects.15.career: Mars square the North Node: the way you push isn't always the way you'll grow. Sometimes the stronger move is to wait for the right conversation.

natal.item.aspects.16.career: Mars trines your Midheaven, so effort and reputation work together: when you put steady energy behind a public goal, it shows and it's rewarded. This is one of the easiest career aspects to have, but it isn't automatic; trines reward use. Your drive builds slowly (Mars in Taurus), so the career payoff comes from sustained effort on something you chose, not from bursts.

natal.item.aspects.17.career: Jupiter opposes Saturn almost exactly, mirroring your Sun–Saturn opposition: expansion and caution pulling in opposite directions. At work, it's the pull between "grow, take the bigger chance" and "consolidate, be sensible". Handled well, it gives you excellent judgement about risk: you can see both the opportunity and the cost. Handled badly, you swing between overreaching and freezing. Decide on the size of a step in advance, then take it.

natal.item.aspects.18.career: Uranus conjunct Neptune: a generational blend of originality and idealism. In your 1st and 2nd houses, it makes you want work that is both new and meaningful.

natal.item.aspects.19.career: Neptune sextile Pluto: a generational aspect, quietly supporting your ability to work with depth and imagination together.

natal.overview.big3.overview: Your Sun in Cancer, Moon in Aries and Sagittarius rising make a protective core with a fiery heart and an adventurous face. At the centre (Sun in Cancer, in the 8th house, right next to Jupiter) is someone who cares deeply, holds things together for others and is trusted with what matters. Your feelings, though, run on Aries fire: quick, honest, needing action and a sense of beginning. These two square each other, so what you aim for and what you need can feel at odds, careful service on one side and a restless wish to start something on the other. Your Sagittarius rising shows the world an open, curious, candid person with a big-picture view, and your Moon trines your Ascendant almost exactly, so what you feel is visible and reads as genuine. Together: a carer with a fighter's heart and an explorer's manner.
natal.overview.big3.career: For work, this blend wants meaning, initiative and freedom at once. You'll do your best work when you're protecting something worth protecting (Cancer Sun) while starting things and leading from the front (Aries Moon), with room to say what you think (Sagittarius rising). Roles that are all care and no initiative will bore you; roles that are all pace and no meaning will hollow you out. Look for work that lets you be both the steady pair of hands and the person who says "let's try it".

natal.overview.planets.overview: Your planets describe a thoughtful, idealistic and very responsible person. Mercury in Leo in the 9th gives a mind made for big ideas and clear conviction. Venus in Gemini in the 7th thrives on lively partnership. Mars in Taurus builds slowly and stubbornly, and trines your Midheaven. Jupiter sits on your Sun, but opposes Saturn in Capricorn, which is sitting with Neptune and Uranus in the earth sign of structure: a generation's stellium, made personal by its place in your 1st and 2nd houses. Pluto in the 12th works quietly underneath. Your North Node in Aquarius points towards sharing ideas widely and in plain terms. And your Midheaven at the last degree of Leo asks to be seen. It's a chart that holds a lot of responsibility, with real creative fire looking for an outlet.
natal.overview.planets.career: The working pattern is clear: big ideas (Mercury), steady drive (Mars), a lot of trust from others (Jupiter on the Sun) and a strong sense of duty around money and security (Saturn in the 2nd). Your career grows when your ideas get a visible platform with your name on it (Leo Midheaven), built at a pace you can sustain. The main brake is caution about income, not lack of ability.

natal.overview.aspects.overview: The tightest patterns in your chart are two near-exact oppositions sharing Saturn: Sun opposite Saturn, and Jupiter opposite Saturn, with your Sun and Jupiter conjunct almost to the minute. Your Moon squares all three, making a T-square with the Moon as the focus. Around that core sit a stellium of Saturn, Uranus and Neptune in Capricorn, and a smooth Mars–Midheaven trine. It's a chart built on tension between growth and caution, with the emotional life (the Moon) carrying the pressure of resolving it. That pressure is also what makes you capable: you've learned to hold big responsibility, weigh risk carefully and keep going under strain. The release valve is the Moon in Aries: action, honesty and starting something new are how you discharge the tension.
natal.overview.aspects.career: At work this pattern makes you an excellent judge of risk and a reliable person to hand serious responsibility to. It can also make you tired, because your feelings end up carrying the job of deciding between growth and safety. Your career eases when you stop treating every decision as all-or-nothing: agree a step size, take it, review it. Action, not more deliberation, releases the pressure.

natal.career.reading:
Your chart describes someone built for trusted, meaningful, visible work: an adviser, a builder of ideas, a protector of things that matter, who eventually wants their own name on what they do.

The core is your Sun in Cancer, sitting almost exactly on Jupiter in the 8th house. You're the person people bring sensitive matters to. Opportunities tend to come through trust and through responsibility for others' resources, which is why advisory and behind-the-scenes roles have suited you. But your Sun also rules your 10th house, and your Midheaven sits at the very last degree of Leo. That's a calling to be seen for your own contribution: authorship, leadership by expertise, a voice people recognise. Mars trines that Midheaven, so steady, chosen effort turns into reputation.

Where work gets hard: Saturn opposes both your Sun and Jupiter almost exactly, from your 2nd house of earning. Purpose and growth pull one way; security and income pull the other. This is the voice that says "not yet" and "what if the money stops". It has kept you reliable, but it can also keep you in a salaried role long after you've outgrown it. Your Moon squares the whole pattern, so the strain lands on your feelings and your energy. Neptune in your 2nd adds a tendency to be vague about money or to undercharge.

What the current timing asks: right now transiting Venus has just sextiled your Midheaven, Uranus is supporting your Mercury from your 6th house of daily work, and Pluto is squaring your Mars, a slow pressure on how you use your drive. Over the next month, Mars crosses your Midheaven: a classic window for a visible, deliberate career move. Use it for a decision you've already thought through, not a sudden leap.

highlights.title: Midheaven
highlights.why: At the last degree of Leo, ruled by your Sun: your public role wants authorship and visibility. Work where your name is on what you produce matters more to you than it does to most, and anonymity inside someone else's output will keep feeling wrong.

highlights.title: Sun Opposition Saturn
highlights.why: Almost exact, from your 2nd house of earning. It's the central career tension in your chart: purpose against security. It makes you careful and expert, and it's also the voice that can keep you in a safe role too long. Decide with a plan and a date, not by waiting.

highlights.title: Sun Conjunction Jupiter
highlights.why: Exact to within a few minutes, in the 8th house. Trust is your career currency: people bring you sensitive, high-stakes work. It's why advisory work fits, and why referrals, not advertising, are likely to be your best source of opportunity.

highlights.title: 2nd House
highlights.why: Saturn and Neptune both live in your house of earning. You build income through expertise and patience, but you're prone to undercharging or avoiding the money conversation. Clear rates and written terms protect you more than they would most people.

highlights.title: Mars Trine Midheaven
highlights.why: Your effort and your reputation work together. Steady, chosen effort behind a public goal is noticed and rewarded, and transiting Mars crosses this Midheaven in late November, which makes this an active point this month.

natal.month.reading:
The month has two halves. Until mid-November it's a time for review rather than launch: transiting Mercury and Venus are both retrograde and both turn direct on 14 November, Mercury squares your own Mercury around 8–10 November, and Venus squares your Sun, Jupiter and Saturn between 5 and 14 November. Expect second thoughts about money, worth and commitments, and use them: rework your numbers, your pitch and your terms rather than signing anything new.

The tone lifts from 12–14 November, when the Sun trines your Sun and Jupiter and sextiles your Saturn: a good moment for confidence and for a sensible plan to come together. Then the career window opens. The Sun squares your Midheaven around 19–21 November, a nudge to make your direction visible, and transiting Mars crosses your Midheaven, exact on 23–24 November: energy for a deliberate, public move. Saturn trines your Mercury from 24 November, steadying your thinking and backing careful decisions. Push in the last week; prepare in the first three.

dates.note: Mercury squares your Mercury: second thoughts about your plan are useful; revise, don't decide.
Mercury and Venus turn direct; the Sun trines your Sun and Jupiter. Confidence returns.
The Sun squares your Midheaven: make your direction visible to one or two people who matter.
Mars crosses your Midheaven: the strongest day this month for a deliberate career move.
Saturn trines your Mercury: good for careful plans, contracts and serious conversations.
